TIPS

A better first trace

  1. Keep it steady. A fixed camera works best.
  2. Keep it short. Half a second before impact, ball visible. Up to 30 seconds.
  3. Let the ball stand out. Good light and contrast help.
  4. Automatic first. If the ball cannot be identified, the app abstains — it will not invent a path.
  5. Keep this tab visible while exporting.
